people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.
translations.bsb: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and carefully follow these statutes.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
translations.asv: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
